description:
A v2.0 central navigation map by Lee Sharks / Rex Fraction / the Assembly, with named machine-system contributors in specification, audit, gap-analysis, and construction roles.

The document represents the Crimson Hexagon through three layers—narrative/visionary, systems/operating, and interactive/oracular—plus engines, rooms, operators, personas, witnesses, events, crisis protocols, pedagogical pathways, and machine-readable relations. Its 94% completeness score, ASPI value, audit judgments, and inventory counts are archive-internal metrics dated January 13, 2026. Many rooms, DOIs, and systems were planned or pending at this version. The map has since been superseded through later versions, with v7.0 identified as current.
